title: docs(adr): record the stage-8 retirement of the four security-catalog row objects in the ADRs that name them
body:
Fixes #22978
Clause-②: no

docs only — no package ships docs/adr/**. This diff touches only `docs/adr/**`, a Tier H governed surface: the PR stays a draft and lands on the maintainer's approval.

## What this changes

ADR-0131 D2/D3/D13, carried out by #15204 stage 8 (`66949b7729`, PR #23222, merged 2026-10-13), stopped registering `sys_position`, `sys_permission_set`, `sys_position_permission_set` and `sys_capability`, and unwired the ADR-0094 `permission` projector, its boot reconcile and the data-door write-throughs. The tables and their rows stay until the ADR-0131 D10 migration. Nine of the eleven ADR files on this card still named those objects or that machinery as live. Each now records the retirement in the form AGENTS.md rule 13 names, an amended status line, plus a dated note at each section that names them:

- `· **Amended** (2026-10-14, ADR-0131 …)` on the status line. ADR-0017 used this form for ADR-0131 D13's `sys_view_definition` retirement.
- `> **RETIRED 2026-10-13 (#15204 stage 8, by execution of ADR-0131 …)**` where a mechanism the ADR itself decided is gone. ADR-0006 v4's D1 is the precedent.
- `> **Note (2026-10-14) — …**` where the decision stands and only the stored object it names is gone. ADR-0061 D5 is the precedent.

**No decision is rewritten: every edit is a pure insertion.** Each file was compared with `difflib.SequenceMatcher` against the merge base `18cd410dc4`: 36 insert opcodes, 0 replace, 0 delete. No heading changes (the diff has no `+#` or `-#` line), so no anchor that other files cite moves. ADR-0131 is linked with the sibling spelling `./0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md`, without a fragment, as all 25 existing links to it in the corpus are written.

This is a leaf of the #15194 epic subtree. `content/docs/**` (the devx lane's own card) and `packages/**` are untouched.

## Per-file record

| File | Passage | Note written | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0029-kernel-object-ownership-…` | D1 ownership table, `plugin-sharing` row: `sys_permission_set`, `sys_*_permission_set` | status segment; Note under D1 | the row names two retired row objects; D1's ownership rule stands |
| `0057-erp-authorization-core-…` | status line: "realizes them as flat `sys_position`"; the path note's `sys-position.object.ts` | status segment | the status line itself names the retired object, and stage 8 deleted that file |
| `0057-system-data-lifecycle-…` | none | nothing | `git grep -c -E 'sys_position\|sys_permission_set\|sys_capability\|permission-set-projection' -- docs/adr/0057-system-data-lifecycle-and-retention.md` exits 1 (zero hits). The control is the same grep on the ERP 0057, which counts 2 |
| `0066-unified-authorization-model` | principle item 2 (records edited in Setup); D1 "Landed" (materialized into `sys_capability`); D5 (sets land as `sys_permission_set`) with "What stays unchanged"; refinement ⑨ (the `sys_capability` seed row) | status segment; 4 Notes | each passage names a retired row object as a live store; the three-way separation stands |
| `0086-authz-metadata-config-…` | Re-evaluation: the status table's D5/P1 seeder rows; ⚠️ item 1 (projection and write-through); the restated D1 table's Assignment row (`sys_position_permission_set`) | status segment; 2 Notes; 1 RETIRED inside item 1 | this ADR's status line sends readers to the Re-evaluation for "the current, code-grounded status of every decision", so the notes go there |
| `0090-permission-model-v2-…` | D3 rename table (`sys_position`, `sys_position_permission_set`); D5 (`everyone` bound through `sys_position_permission_set`; `sys_capability`); D8 (`sys_position_permission_set`-like tables) | status line; 3 Notes | the renames and rules stand, but the tables they name are retired |
| `0091-grant-lifecycle-…` | D1 (binding table left undated); Non-goals bullet 1; Phasing L2 (`sys_position.delegatable`) | status segment; 3 Notes | the reasoning stands; the table and the column are gone |
| `0094-sys-permission-set-pure-projection` | TL;DR, D1, D2, D3, D4, Consequences (the open question), the 2026-07-14 addendum's per-type table and the `scope` tradeoff, the 2026-09-04 amendment's "one major left to live" | status segment; RETIRED under the TL;DR, D2, D3, D4 and at the end of the 2026-09-04 amendment; Notes under D1, the Consequences and the addendum | ADR-0131 D2/D3 retires the record's whole projection; D1 stands, generalized by ADR-0131 D3 |
| `0103-managedby-write-policy-…` | Context item 2 and its "Not to be confused with" block (provenance-column objects); the v16 addendum's writable-set list; the #4671 addendum's three link tables | status segment; 3 Notes | the policy stands; one link table and two provenance-column objects are retired |
| `0126-packaged-metadata-customization-model` | §4 (D2): "the permission projection keeps its own row-state door"; §8 (D5) item 3: how `sys_permission_set.active` and the ledger relate | status segment; 2 Notes | the projection and its row are gone; ADR-0131 §4 moves `active` into the definition's lifecycle |
| `0131-total-organization-ownership-…` | none written | nothing | this is the deciding record. D2, D3, D13 and §4 already describe these objects as retiring, §1 and §7 are dated context, and §8's C3 row is the plan. Its status line says execution state lives on the epic, not on that line |

**Left alone and listed, not noted (dated context, or text that already reads as retired):**

- 0057 ERP: the Context axis table ("ObjectStack today: `sys_permission_set`"), and D5's `sys_role_permission_set`, which the status line already marks superseded (D4–D7).
- 0086: the original body (Context "What is already true", D3, D5, P1, Consequences). The ADR keeps every decision's current status in its Re-evaluation, where the notes go. The Net assessment points back to ⚠️ item 1.
- 0094: Context (dated: "had two writable stores"), D5 (already RETIRED 2026-08-09), Alternatives considered, References.
- 0126: §1.1, "What exists today — measured" (dated context).
- 0131: §1.2 item 4, §1.3, §5 and §7 (dated); D2, D3, D13 and §4 (the retiring text); §8's C3 row.

## Facts the notes state, and where each was read (`main` at `18cd410dc4`)

- **Stage 8** (`66949b7729`): its own message says the objects are "no longer registered" and "Tables and rows stay for the organization-ownership migration (ADR-0131 D10)". Of the unwired modules it says "The modules stay for 7a/7b to delete". The ADR-0087 entry is `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.catalog-row-objects-retired.ts`.
- **The projection module:** `permission-set-projection.ts` is still in the tree. `security-plugin.ts` does not register it, and its deletion is #15204 stage 7a (#22975, open). Stage 7b (`5c9bfb0d3f`, PR #23302) already deleted the position write-through and the row-only backfill. None of the eleven ADRs names those two.
- **The projector seam stays.** `git grep -c "this.runMutationProjector(" -- packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` answers 7. `security-catalog-echo.ts` (PR #23334, `6d96721faa`) registers the seam for `permission` and `position` and writes no row. ADR-0094's D2 note and its 2026-09-04 note both say this, so neither can be read as "the seam is gone".
- **The seeder:** `bootstrap-declared-permissions.ts` was deleted by stage 6b-2 (`c8a9783eca`, PR #22900).
- **`PositionSchema`** has the keys `name`, `label`, `description`, `permissionSets`, `delegatable` and `protection`, and no team key. The ADR-0090 D8 note depends on this.
- **The D12 gate** reads `delegatable` "from the security catalog by name" (`delegated-admin-gate.ts`). The ADR-0091 L2 note depends on this.
- **Outside the eleven:** `git grep -c -E 'sys_position|sys_permission_set|sys_capability' -- 'docs/adr/*.md'` lists exactly the ten numbers on this card. No other ADR names the four objects.

## Gates — head `abc9f1aa3d` (this branch merged with `origin/main` `18cd410dc4`)

Every exit code was captured before any pipe.

- **The five named gates**, all exit 0: `pnpm check:adr-anchors`, `pnpm check:adr-links` (758 relative link destinations under `docs/adr/`, all found), `pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors` (2336 anchors across 142 records, all found), `pnpm check:nul-bytes` and `pnpm check:doc-authoring`.
- **Derived gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` lists 19 commands. 18 exit 0.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` exits 3 with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (`@objectstack/formula` is not built). That is **NOT MEASURED**, and it was not built for, because no package source is in this diff.
  - `--ran` reconciliation: "19 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 18 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED", exit 0.
- **No build and no test suite ran:** the diff holds no package source.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**
- 9 份 ADR 提到了岗位、权限集、岗位-权限集绑定、能力这四个“目录行对象”，或提到了 ADR-0094 的权限集投影机制。这些地方现在都标注了“已退役”：状态行追加一段 Amended 修订记录，受影响的章节下各加一段带日期的说明。
- 原文没有改动，全部是插入，标题也没动，其他文件引用这些 ADR 的锚点不受影响。
- 有两份没改：ADR-0131 是做出退役决定的那份，原文本来就写着“退役”；ADR-0057 的数据生命周期那份没有提到这四个对象。

**为什么改**
- 第 8 阶段（#15204）已在 10 月 13 日合并，这四个对象已经从系统中摘除，但上面这些 ADR 还把它们写成在用的数据表。按 AGENTS.md 第 13 条，被后来决定退役的内容，要在原 ADR 上留下修订记录。不留的话，人和 AI 读到旧 ADR，会以为这些表还在，照着写出错误的代码或元数据。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
- 只改文档，不涉及任何发布的包，对运行时没有影响。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 说明里的每条事实都对照当前 main 核实过：哪个提交退役了什么；表和数据保留到 D10 迁移；投影模块仍在代码树里，等 7a 阶段删除。7a 落地后，“模块仍在树上”这句会变成历史描述，但说明带了日期，不会误导读者。

**席位意见**


**你要做的**
- `docs/adr/**` 是受管路径（Tier H），需要你审阅后批准，或亲手合并。
- 一个可选决定：ADR-0131 是否也要在状态行记一笔“C3 第 8 阶段已执行”？本 PR 没有加，因为它的状态行明确写着执行进度由 epic 记录，不放在状态行。
